properties.name: rocksdb 0.24 → 0.25: the same crate, RocksDB 10.4.2 → 11.8.1, with stores proved forward and back; the hold #651 recorded for it is removed
properties.rationale: The evidence is fact:rocksdb-0-25-opens-twenty-real-stores-identically-and-0-77-0-reads-what-it-wrote-2026-10-02, carried into the committed design with this change. Over 20 real stores, forward and rollback both hold, and the rollback is real: 11.8.1 writes table format_version 7, which 10.4.2 reads. The route was confirmed by Anthony's acceptance of the dependency requirement and the merge order he gave on 2026-10-02 (#651 first).
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The first bump under req:reflow2-keeps-its-dependencies-at-or-near-their-latest-releases. Cargo.toml `rocksdb = "0.25"` and the lock (librocksdb-sys 0.17.3+10.4.2 → 0.19.0+11.8.1). No reflow2 source changed. The comments in Cargo.toml and crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/mod.rs (art:foundation) now name 0.25 and the measurement. dependency-holds.toml loses the rocksdb hold #651 recorded while this was in flight, and the currency checker reads rocksdb as current. The CHANGELOG entry sits under Changed.
